CONTROLS

TOUCHLeft thumb moves. Drag anywhere on the right to aim. Hold FIRE to shoot, and slide that thumb to aim while firing. MELEE bashes, FRAG and PLASMA throw grenades, ZOOM scopes in, SPRINT toggles a faster run (the gun lowers while you sprint), SWAP cycles weapons, II pauses.
CONTROLLERLeft stick move, right stick aim, RT fire, LT zoom, left stick click sprint, A jump (brake in the rover), X reload, Y swap weapon, B or right stick click melee, RB frag, LB plasma, D-pad up use or take or drive, D-pad left and right pick a slot, Start pause. Menus: D-pad or left stick and A. Rumble on hits and shots.
KEYBOARDWASD move, mouse aim and fire, Space jump, R reload, V or middle click melee, Y grappling hook onto an enemy Hornet in team battle (punch the pilot out), C crouch, G frag grenade, H plasma grenade, Q swap weapon, 1 and 2 pick a weapon slot, Z or right click zoom, hold Shift to sprint, E to get in or out of the rover, P or Esc pause.
WEAPONSYou carry two weapons at a time. Every weapon hangs on a weapon rack: one just ahead of where you start, and two more out in the valley. Walk up, look at the weapon you want and press E (or TAKE) to swap it in for the weapon you are holding, which goes back on the rack. Grab a weapon you already carry to restock its ammo. The sniper rifle zooms for a scope view and a headshot drops almost anything.
OPEN WORLDThe arena is now a big valley: ridges, plateaus, a river basin and sheer cliffs. Cliffs and very steep slopes can't be climbed, so find a ramp or go round, and long falls hurt. Raiders hunt you across the terrain, and when you kill one the others nearby may panic and run for a few seconds.
HORNETWalk up to the Hornet and press E to fly it. Mouse aims, W/S fly, A/D slide, Space climbs, C descends. Left click fires the guns. Keep your view on an enemy until the box turns red, then right click (or F) to fire a homing missile. Land to get out.
ROCKET LAUNCHERTwo rockets per load, then a slow reload. Rockets explode on impact with a big blast that also hurts you if you are close. Zoom gives it a scope view, press zoom again for more magnification.
SHOTGUNPump action with ten pellets a shot and a huge kick: raiders you hit are blasted backward and stagger, and ones you kill go flying. It is deadly up close and weak at range. Reload feeds one shell at a time, and you can fire at any point to interrupt it.
ROVERWalk up to the green rover (a cyan marker floats above it) and tap DRIVE. The left stick steers and sets throttle, BRAKE stops it. Stop next to one of your marines and he hops onto the turret and works the gun himself. Get out and he hops off. Ram raiders to run them down.
GRENADESFrag grenades bounce off the ground and walls and go off after about a second and a half. Plasma grenades stick to whatever they hit, raiders and the rover included, and go off a little later with a rising beep. You start with 3 frag and 2 plasma, and grenades turn up in ammo drops and between waves. Blasts hurt you too.

Shields recharge when you stay out of fire. Health only returns from green pickups and between waves. Headshots hit harder. A melee bash kills a grunt in one hit.
